calendars.note: Default native scheduler provider. Reuses calendars already connected to macOS Calendar, including Google, without asking Yulu for separate Google OAuth.
Legacy native scheduler provider. Yulu owns scheduling; AI calendar context should come from the selected Agent's MCP connectors when available.

gog.note: When true, Yulu may reuse the host gog connector for calendar reads.

feishu.note: Connector switches are safe config only; credentials stay in env vars or the host agent/plugin.

notion.note: Legacy compatibility flag. Agent Console prefers the selected Agent's Notion connector plus agent_console.destinations.

zulip.note: Legacy compatibility flag. Agent Console prefers the selected Agent's Zulip connector plus agent_console.destinations.

theme.note: Theme is config-backed. family is one of default/ayu/paper/custom; mode is auto/light/dark. Ayu and Paper are families, not separate light/dark themes.

audio.note: backend=daemon 使用原生 ScreenCaptureKit + AVFoundation，不需要 BlackHole；mic_device 在原生 daemon 中选择麦克风，system_audio_device 仅 SoX fallback 使用

hermes.note: Set final_engine=realtime.engine to "hermes" to delegate STT to Hermes' configured/default provider. If Hermes is configured for Grok/xAI, Yulu sends the audio to that provider through Hermes' credentials/config and preserves returned speaker diarization. This path never calls Yulu STT from Hermes.

dictation.note: Experimental low-latency voice input (`yulu dictate`). Use auto to inherit realtime.engine/final_engine, or set hermes/mlx/whisper explicitly. STT receives audio plus glossary hints only; selected prompts are reserved for post-STT processing such as translation. Hermes translation uses the translate_* budget because it may need a second postprocess call.

realtime.note: Realtime/live captions run a FASTER model than the final pass so they keep up with wall-clock audio for arbitrarily-long recordings. mlx_model defaults to turbo (~4-8x faster than large-v3); the final transcript is re-done with transcription.mlx.model. chunk_sec = caption cadence; chunk_max_sec caps how much audio one live chunk transcribes so a backlog can't snowball into one slow mega-chunk.

diarization.note: Speaker attribution ('who said what'), v0.6. OFF by default — set enabled=true to provision (setup/yulu migrate then pip-install the cross-platform sherpa-onnx engine into the daemon interpreter + download ~33 MB of ONNX models, both idempotent & offline-by-default). Runs POST-recording, OFF the realtime critical path: the live caption stream never waits on diarization, and a missing engine/model degrades to today's plain transcript with no error. provider=sherpa-onnx is the only backend today. seg_model/emb_model: leave "" to use the managed ~/.config/yulu/models/diarization/{segmentation,campplus}.onnx, or an absolute ~/path to override. num_speakers: null = auto-cluster (a calendar-attendee count, when available, is used as a free prior); set an integer to force a known headcount (the reliable lever for Chinese, where auto over-splits). threshold (auto mode only, ignored when num_speakers is set): lower is more sensitive and can split into more speakers; 0.6 is the conservative default to reduce phantom speakers; uncertain clustering fails toward recoverable under-merge (two people one label, fixable in the UI) rather than many phantom speakers.

agent.note: Agent Console auto-detects Codex, Claude Code, Hermes, or OpenClaw when command is null. Set command to any Agent CLI wrapper for Gemini, Grok, or custom runtimes.

plugins.note: Yulu-side filter for capabilities shown in Agent Console. Summary is always available; add notion/zulip/calendar from the console when you want them visible.

zulip.note: Legacy output fallback. Agent Console uses per-agent destinations and the selected Agent's Zulip plugin/account.

notion.note: Legacy output fallback. Agent Console uses per-agent destinations and the selected Agent's Notion plugin/account.

status_agent.note: Menu-bar agent: recording indicator + menu items + global hotkeys. Hotkey key names use Carbon virtual keys; modifiers are cmd/shift/alt/ctrl.
